summary: Super League Enterprise, Inc. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $2,229,000 of common stock under a sales agreement with Benchmark Company and StoneX Financial, dated August 18, 2026. The offering is conducted under Rule 415(a)(4), with agents receiving up to 1.0% commission. Sales are limited by the one-third public float rule per Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 (public float ≈ $6.69M). No special-situation event; this is a routine shelf takedown, so no special-situation classification applies.
